Nell, a passenger in a mustard raincoat, arrives at the ticket counter holding her crimson scarf. She lays it down to free her hands.
Nell finds her cream paper ticket in her black bag. Seeing her train stop outside, she turns toward the platform. The scarf stays on the wooden counter.
Nell walks left toward the open train door, ticket in hand. Behind her, station attendant Ken spots the forgotten crimson scarf.
Ken lifts the scarf from the counter and waves it high. Nell sees him from the platform and turns back.
At the platform doorway Ken holds out the scarf. Nell takes it and smiles in thanks. The transfer finishes in her hands.
Nell slips the scarf around her neck and steps aboard the open train. Ken stays on the platform.
From the platform we see Nell seated inside through the carriage window, wearing the crimson scarf. She smiles and waves to Ken as her train rolls away. The counter inside the station is empty.
